Fields.Name: Attacker Character ID
Fields.Description: Character ID of the thrower (cXXXX model number as XXXX). 0: the player.

Fields.Name: Defender Character ID
Fields.Description: Character ID of the character being thrown (cXXXX model number as XXXX). 0: the player.

Fields.Name: Max Distance
Fields.Description: Maximum distance in metres between the two characters' reference points (see the Range Dummy Poly fields). 0 or less: the row never matches.

Fields.Name: Facing Difference Min
Fields.Description: Lowest allowed difference between the defender's and the attacker's facing, in degrees (−180 to 180; 0 = facing the same way, ±180 = facing each other). If Min is greater than Max the range wraps through 180: for example 90 and −90 accept every difference from 90 to 180 and from −180 to −90, as used by ripostes. Backstabs use −90 to 90.

Fields.Name: Facing Difference Max
Fields.Description: Highest allowed difference between the defender's and the attacker's facing, in degrees. See Facing Difference Min.

Fields.Name: Max Height Above
Fields.Description: How far above the attacker's reference point the defender's may be, in metres.

Fields.Name: Max Height Below
Fields.Description: How far below the attacker's reference point the defender's may be, in metres.

Fields.Name: Max Angle to Defender
Fields.Description: Maximum angle in degrees between the attacker's facing and the direction to the defender (a half-angle: 60 accepts defenders up to 60° to either side). 180: any direction.

Fields.Name: Throw Type ID
Fields.Description: Must equal the Throw Type ID of the attack that triggers the throw (AtkParam).

Fields.Name: Attacker Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation the thrower plays when the throw connects. Below 0: none.

Fields.Name: Defender Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation the thrown character plays when the throw connects. Below 0: none.

Fields.Name: Escape Points
Fields.Description: Number of successful button-mash cycles the thrown character needs to break free (see Escape Cycle Time and Escape Presses per Cycle). 0: the throw can't be escaped.

Fields.Name: Escape Cycle Time
Fields.Description: Length of one button-mash cycle in milliseconds. Each cycle in which the thrown character makes at least Escape Presses per Cycle inputs removes one Escape Point.

Fields.Name: Wall Check Radius % (Upper)
Fields.Description: The throw fails if a sphere cast from the attacker to the defender, at 80% of the characters' height, hits map collision. Radius = this % of the larger of the two characters' capsule radii. 0: this cast is skipped.

Fields.Name: Wall Check Radius % (Lower)
Fields.Description: As Wall Check Radius % (Upper), for the cast at 42% of the characters' height. 0: this cast is skipped.

Fields.Name: Operation Type
Fields.Description: Operation type

Fields.Name: Attacker Throw State
Fields.Description: The throw state the attacker must be in. 0: any state. A character whose throws are disabled can never throw.

Fields.Name: Follow Dummy Poly
Fields.Description: 0: the joined character is placed at the absorb dummy poly once. 1: it keeps following that dummy poly while the throw lasts.

Fields.Name: Throw Type
Fields.Description: The throw-condition states both characters must be in (SpEffect Throw Condition). 0: normal throw or grab, neither character in a special state. 1: backstab, the same, but also allowed on a parried defender. 10/11: the attacker is in state 2/3 (10 is a jump-attack stab on the head). 20: the defender is parried (state 10). 21–25: the defender is in state 11–15 (22 fallen off a mount, 23 special backstab, 24 asleep, 25 stance broken). A character in state 1 can never throw or be thrown.

Fields.Name: Escape Presses per Cycle
Fields.Description: Inputs the thrown character must make within one Escape Cycle Time to remove one Escape Point.

Fields.Name: Facing Without Absorb Dummy Poly
Fields.Description: How a character is turned when no absorb dummy poly places it. 0: faces the other character. 1: faces away from it (180°). 255: keeps its own facing.

Fields.Name: Turn Attacker
Fields.Description: Does the throwing side turn?

Fields.Name: Skip Weapon Throw Check
Fields.Description: If on, the attacker's weapon doesn't need Enable Throw (EquipParamWeapon). If off, the throw only matches when the weapon in the attacking hand allows throws.

Fields.Name: Skip Wall Check
Fields.Description: If on, the sphere casts that stop throws through walls (Wall Check Radius %) are skipped.

Fields.Name: Flatten Absorb Position
Fields.Description: If on, the absorb dummy poly position is corrected as if both characters stood on flat ground, so slopes don't tilt the joined character's placement.

Fields.Name: Fall Assist When Following Ends
Fields.Description: If on, when following ends the joined character is kept from falling off ledges, as fall-prevention walls do.

Fields.Name: Push Back From Walls While Following
Fields.Description: If on, the character holding the absorb dummy poly is pushed back when the joined character touches a wall or fall-prevention wall, so it doesn't end up inside a wall or off a ledge.

Fields.Name: Attacker Absorb Dummy Poly
Fields.Description: Dummy poly on the attacker where the defender is placed during the throw (facing opposite the dummy poly's direction). Takes priority: when this is not 0, Defender Absorb Dummy Poly is ignored. 0: not used.

Fields.Name: Defender Absorb Dummy Poly
Fields.Description: Dummy poly on the defender where the attacker is placed during the throw. Only used when Attacker Absorb Dummy Poly is 0. 0: not used.

Fields.Name: Backstab Start: Max Distance
Fields.Description: For backstabs (Throw Type 1), replaces Max Distance in the check that starts the backstab; the row it finds is then used for the throw itself.

Fields.Name: Backstab Start: Facing Difference Min
Fields.Description: For backstabs (Throw Type 1), replaces Facing Difference Min in the check that starts the backstab.

Fields.Name: Backstab Start: Facing Difference Max
Fields.Description: For backstabs (Throw Type 1), replaces Facing Difference Max in the check that starts the backstab.

Fields.Name: Backstab Start: Max Height Above
Fields.Description: For backstabs (Throw Type 1), replaces Max Height Above in the check that starts the backstab.

Fields.Name: Backstab Start: Max Height Below
Fields.Description: For backstabs (Throw Type 1), replaces Max Height Below in the check that starts the backstab.

Fields.Name: Backstab Start: Max Angle to Defender
Fields.Description: For backstabs (Throw Type 1), replaces Max Angle to Defender in the check that starts the backstab.

Fields.Name: Attacker Range Dummy Poly
Fields.Description: Dummy poly on the attacker used as its position for the distance, height and angle checks (and the wall-check casts). -1: the character's position.

Fields.Name: Defender Range Dummy Poly
Fields.Description: Dummy poly on the defender used as its position for the distance, height and angle checks (and the wall-check casts). -1: the character's position.

Fields.Name: Absorb Model Blend Time
Fields.Description: Seconds over which the joined character's model moves from where it was to its place in the throw animation after its capsule snaps to the absorb dummy poly. 0: no blend, the model starts in place.

Fields.Name: Follow End Blend Time
Fields.Description: Seconds over which the joined character's model blends back to its capsule when following ends.
